events.subtitle: Last Live @BODY&SOUL
events.category: Modern jazz / Sextet / BODY&SOUL final appearance
events.factual_description: BODY&SOUL presents Junko Moriya Sextet on September 20, 2026, with doors at 5:30 PM and sets at 6:30 PM and 8:00 PM. The official venue page lists Junko Moriya on piano, Yoshiro Okazaki on trumpet, Kazuhiko Kondo on alto saxophone, Masanori Okazaki on tenor saxophone, Daiki Yasukagawa on bass and Juasa Kanoh on drums. Moriya's official site identifies this as the sextet's last live performance at BODY&SOUL, noting that the group has worked there for many years and that the club closes after its September 26 grand finale. The venue lists a music charge of ¥7,000 before tax / ¥7,700 including tax, with a student price of ¥5,000 including tax.

en.why_it_matters: Moriya's sextet has treated BODY&SOUL as a long-running home, and this is its documented final night in that room before the club closes. Piano, trumpet, alto and tenor over bass and drums give her writing the compression and color of a small jazz orchestra without losing combo-level improvisational freedom. The farewell is to a specific ensemble-place relationship, not simply another strong Tokyo jazz date.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for this if September overlaps with Tokyo, especially if hearing one of BODY&SOUL's established working bands in its home room matters to the trip. It is worth building the Shibuya evening around; if the club's September 26 grand finale is also possible and the two compete for limited Tokyo time, preserve the finale.

es.why_it_matters: El sexteto de Moriya ha tenido en BODY&SOUL una casa de trabajo durante años, y ésta es su última noche documentada en esa sala antes del cierre del club. Piano, trompeta, alto y tenor sobre bajo y batería le dan a sus arreglos la presión y el color de una pequeña orquesta de jazz sin perder la libertad improvisatoria de un combo. La despedida es de una relación concreta entre un ensamble y su lugar, no simplemente otra buena fecha de jazz en Tokio.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente si septiembre coincide con Tokio, sobre todo si importa escuchar a una de las bandas de trabajo de BODY&SOUL dentro de su propia casa. Vale construir la noche de Shibuya alrededor de esta fecha; si también es posible el grand finale del club el 26 de septiembre y compiten por tiempo limitado en Tokio, conservaría el finale.
